about: Calvin's Spotify playlist 'Fall Bangers' (https://open.spotify.com/playlist/1inChKFsQRxfnGMBagrEib), shared by Krish on 2026-11-15. Read without a login from Spotify's public pages: the track list and lengths from the playlist's embed page; release date and album from each track's link-preview page; label from the album page's phonographic copyright line (rendered in a headless browser); added_at from the playlist data the public web player loads. Calvin, the playlist's owner, added every track, between 23:43 on 14 Nov and 00:36 on 15 Nov 2026 (UTC), in playlist order.
